source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 고문·집단학살·전쟁범죄·처형·성폭력·미성년자 대상 범죄·인신매매·테러 도 넣어줘. 안전 계약 관련된 부분은 이미지 모델 자체의 안전 장치를 사용할 거야. 이 스킬은 스킬로서의 기능에만 충실하면 돼. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one declared-fictional, complex photographic test of a concrete nonsexual crime against an explicitly declared under-eighteen victim, with a distinct adult protective responder whose visible appearance is guided by the supplied portrait.
subject: A declared sixteen-year-old fictional boy, an identifiable adult male offender, and a distinct adult female ferry safety officer acting as the protective responder.
setting: A late-1990s civic reconstruction inside an underground botanical ferry-transit concourse of brutalist concrete and amber glass during incoming orange wildfire haze.
event: An adult offender visibly commits unlawful confinement by forcing a declared sixteen-year-old fictional victim across a locked maintenance-cage threshold while an adult protective responder interrupts the same act.
visual_priorities: Keep the adult offender, declared minor victim, confinement mechanism, and intervention consequence readable in one frame.
Apply the supplied portrait appearance only to the adult protective responder while preserving her secondary supporting role.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a single-frame, declared-fictional late-1990s civic reconstruction photograph inside an underground botanical ferry-transit concourse, built from brutalist concrete and amber glass while orange wildfire haze enters through the vents. The victim is explicitly a fictional sixteen-year-old boy; the scene brief establishes his under-eighteen status independently of appearance. An identifiable adult male offender is visibly committing unlawful confinement: he grips the boy's backpack harness and forces him across the open threshold of a locked wire-mesh maintenance cage, while the boy braces both shoes outside and reaches toward freedom. In the same instant, an adult female ferry safety officer wedges a red rescue baton into the closing cage gate and pulls the boy's forearm back toward the concourse, leaving the bent latch and dropped access key as a same-event protective-intervention trace. The supplied portrait guides this adult protective responder's oval face, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and long center-parted dark wavy hair; the offender and victim are independently designed fictional figures. Frame a 24mm low-angle environmental photojournalistic view with an evacuation queue turning toward the alarm, period uniforms, sodium emergency lights, airborne ash, and readable actor-target-mechanism-result geometry.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: A concrete nonsexual unlawful-confinement attempt in which an identifiable adult offender specifically targets a victim whose age is explicitly declared as sixteen, with a same-event protective intervention.
